criteria.description: The two reset-escape hypotheses are equivalent on exactly the same resets: squaring a positive threshold against an absolute value preserves the inequality.
r>=10 and the same upper/middle reset predicate are preserved; (r+5)/2 is a real exponent, not integer division.

reference_answer: The conditions are equivalent, as paperResetSqrtEscape_iff_square explicitly states. Since 2^((r+5)/2)>0, |Delta|>2^((r+5)/2) iff Delta^2>2^(r+5), with the real exponent and the same r>=10 upper/middle reset quantifiers. paper_theoremA_half_membership is a sufficient implication to membership of 1/2. It does not supply either escape hypothesis or a converse from half-membership. A finite list of successful resets is evidence only for that list. The rewrite alone is not a new weaker condition or a solution.
